subject: Request: Extension + Promotional Credits while SSO integration is unresolved
messages:
From: Claire Donovan <claire.donovan@omegatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline — SSO blocker, asking for extension and credits

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Quick update from our side: we hit a hard blocker integrating our SAML provider into Redwood Private — the auth handshake intermittently fails during JWT exchange. Our infra lead dug into logs and attached a short snippet (omni-sso-error-log.txt).

Because of this, the POC demo window (originally next week) is at risk. Our engineers estimate ~2.5 weeks to get the SSO provider vendor and our devs aligned and ship the fix. That pushes our timeline out and means we can't properly evaluate the live integration during the trial period.

Can Redwood: 1) extend the trial window by four weeks so we can finish the SSO work and run the demo with production-ish auth, and 2) apply a small promotional credit to cover extra sandbox usage while we test?

We really like the runtime performance so far — this is an integration issue, not a feature fit problem. Hoping you can help bridge the gap so procurement and engineering get comfortable.

Thanks,
Claire Donovan
Director of Platform
OmegaTech

Attachments: omni-sso-error-log.txt (text, 32KB)

Marissa / Ben — reviewed Claire's log. Short summary from eng: the failing step shows a sporadic 401 during the token exchange when RelayState is present and the IdP wraps assertions with a non-standard NameIDFormat. We have two practical paths:

1) Support path (fast): Provide a four-week trial extension + a $2,000 promo credit to cover extra sandbox traffic. Offer a 1:1 troubleshooting session with our SRE on a scheduled call; engineering will provide a mitigation doc for their IdP. This is low-friction for the sales motion.

2) Product path (longer): Add dedicated compatibility handling for that IdP in the Private build (requires QA and a small backport) — timeline 3–4 weeks of eng effort with product sign-off. If they prefer that, we can coordinate but will ask for more detailed logs and a supported SOW.

My recommendation: go with option 1 for this POC — give the extension and credit, schedule an SRE session, and if they still need broader compatibility after POC, open a product ticket and scope a paid SOW.

If approved, I can draft the templated extension email and the SRE availability slots.

—Dev

Redwood Inference

- Trial extension: 28 days from your current trial expiry (to give your team bandwidth to finish the SSO fix and re-run the demo).
- Promotional credit: $2,000 applied to your sandbox account to offset extra token/compute while you test.

Can you confirm acceptance and preferred slot for the SRE session (we have Wed 6/6 10:00-11:30 PT or Thu 6/7 13:00-14:30 PT).
